chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn al-Mughīrah, from ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever mentions the Name of Allah, Exalted is He, over his wudu (ablution), it is as though he has performed ghusl (ritual bath).

key_terms.اسْمَ اللَّهِ: the Name of Allah, meaning verbal remembrance of Him

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of saying Allah’s Name during wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the merit of mentioning Allah’s Name at the time of wudu (ablution). It indicates the great spiritual effect and added purity associated with beginning wudu (ablution) with dhikr of Allah.
